# Most Wandered

> > Travel guides and expat insights from Tokyo-based wanderer Kirstie, specializing in Japan itineraries, cultural experiences, and living abroad in Asia.

Most Wandered is a travel blog by Kirstie, a Tokyo expat and backpacker since 2015, offering detailed Japan travel guides, itineraries for destinations like Kyoto and Osaka, practical advice on teaching English and moving to Japan, and curated walking tours exploring anime locations and local culture.

## Key Topics

- Japan travel itineraries
- Tokyo expat life
- Kyoto attractions
- JR Pass tips
- Living abroad in Japan
- Teaching English in Japan
- Onsen and sento etiquette
- Cherry blossom viewing (sakura)
- Japanese language learning
- Study abroad programs
- Digital nomad lifestyle
- Kanazawa and beyond the Golden Route
- Asakusa and Sensoji Temple
- Vietnam travel
- Backpacking Asia

## Essential Japan Itineraries

- [The Best 3 Week Japan Itinerary (With Options!)](https://www.mostwandered.com/blog/the-best-3-week-japan-itinerary-with-options): 3-week Japan itinerary with JR Pass tips, Tokyo highlights & hidden gems
- [The Best 2 Week Itinerary For Japan—Full Guide and Costs](https://www.mostwandered.com/blog/the-best-2-week-itinerary-for-japan--full-guide-and-costs): 2-week Japan itinerary: Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka, Nara with budget breakdown
- [Beyond the Golden Route: Where to Go in Japan Besides Tokyo, Kyoto, and Osaka](https://www.mostwandered.com/blog/beyond-the-golden-route-where-to-go-in-japan-besides-tokyo-kyoto-and-osaka): Alternative Japan destinations: Kanazawa, Shirakawa-go beyond golden route
- [Travel Guides and Itineraries](https://www.mostwandered.com/travel): Japan & Asia travel guides hub: Tokyo, Hakone itineraries and local tips

## Tokyo and Kyoto Guides

- [Top Off The Beaten Path Things to do in Tokyo](https://www.mostwandered.com/blog/top-off-the-beaten-path-things-to-do-in-tokyo): Tokyo hidden gems: themed bars, 8bit cafe, local neighborhoods beyond touristy spots
- [Top 20 Things to Do in Kyoto](https://www.mostwandered.com/blog/20-things-to-do-in-kyoto): Kyoto attractions guide: Fushimi Inari, sake museum, 5-day itinerary
